verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਗੁਆਰ ਗਾਇਨ ਚਰਾਵਤ ਜਤਨ ਬਨ ਖੇਤ ਨ ਪਰਤ ਸਬੈ ਚਰਤ ਅਘਾਇ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise guaar gain charaavat jatan ban khet na parat sabai charat aghai kai ||

en.bdb: Just as cowherd grazer grazes his cows very attentively in the jungle and does not let them wander into some fields, and they graze to their satisfaction.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਰਾਜਾ ਧਰਮ ਸਰੂਪ ਰਾਜਨੀਤਿ ਬਿਖੈ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਦੇਸ ਪਰਜਾ ਬਸਤ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise raajaa dharam saroop raajaneet bikhai taa ke dhes parajaa basat sukh pai kai ||

en.bdb: Just as a king who is righteous and just, his subjects live in peace and prosperity.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਹੋਤ ਖੇਵਟ ਚਿਤੰਨ ਸਾਵਧਾਨ ਜਾ ਮੈ ਲਾਗੈ ਨਿਰਬਿਘਨ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਪਾਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise hot khevaT chita(n)n saavadhaan jaa mai laagai nirabighan bohith paar jai kai ||

en.bdb: Just as a sailor is very alert and conscious of his duties, that ship touches the yonder shore without any adverse happenings.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਉਨਮਨਿ ਮਗਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਜੋਿਤ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰੈ ਸਿਖ ਸਮਝਾਇ ਕੈ ॥੪੧੮॥
verses.translit_en: taise gur unaman magan braham joit jeevan mukat karai sikh samajhai kai ||418||

en.bdb: Similarly, the True Guru who has merged with the Light divine of the Lord, like warp and weft of a cloth, alone can make a disciple living emancipated with His teachings.  (418)
